concept: ユーザーが選択したC案「GBAの記憶」。青緑の魔道書、金の装飾、赤橙の炎、紺色の角丸タイル。
regenerate: リポジトリルートで just icons を実行する。原画の再生成や外部API呼び出しは行わず、sipsでmacOS用10サイズを書き出す。
menuBar: StatusBarIcon.swiftで18ptのドット絵を1倍・2倍のビットマップとして生成。待機はテンプレートの輪郭、listeningは暖色の塗り。入力保留でも収録が続く間は塗りを維持。
prompt:
Use case: identity-preserve. Asset type: production macOS application icon.
The input image is a three-column concept board. The user approved ONLY column C, "GBAの記憶", the rightmost large icon. Extract and faithfully recreate that C application icon as one standalone centered square app icon on a genuinely TRANSPARENT canvas. Do not include any part of A, B, the board, typography, state icons, labels or white presentation background.
Preserve the approved C identity: a sharply pixelated, chunky GBA-style blue-green closed spellbook, slight three-quarter tilt with its top edge climbing toward the right, aged-gold pixel corner fittings, ivory pixel page edges at bottom, orange and golden-yellow pixel fire emblem on the front. Dark midnight-navy rounded-square macOS tile behind the book with subtle dimensional depth. Original pixel illustration inspired by handheld RPG magic-tome inventory art. Book fills the tile but fits inside it, clearly stepped square pixels and hard pixel edges, not a smooth/photoreal book. The tile itself has the same smooth rounded-square shape as the reference; the book and flame are pixel art.
Composition: exactly one complete icon, front-facing tile centered, square overall canvas at 1024x1024, generous transparent safe margin of approximately 64 px on every side around the rounded tile, no clipping. A subtle short shadow may be contained inside that transparent margin. No background plane, no text, no letters, no watermark, no extra sparkle, no other props. Keep the restrained original C colors and silhouette. This will be used in Finder at sizes down to 16px, so prioritize the book silhouette and its bright flame over fine texture.
